# Windows LSASS Memory Access
# id: 209d53d4-e7ea-4b06-9c19-b89a824fe768
# source: rules/windows/lsass_process_access.yml
# format: Elasticsearch Lucene
# Field names are the Sigma field names. No product pipeline was applied.

(EventID:10 AND TargetImage:*\\lsass.exe AND (GrantedAccess:(0x1010 OR 0x1410 OR 0x1438 OR 0x143a OR 0x1fffff))) AND (NOT (SourceImage:(*\\csrss.exe OR *\\wininit.exe)))
